newsitem.title: USA: American Educational says group buys shrs.
newsitem.headline: American Educational says group buys shrs.

text.p: American Educational Products Inc said on Tuesday that privately held Geneve Corp of Stamford, Conn., has purchased 238,340 shares of the company's common stock, or a 26 percent stake.
Geneve Corporation is a large private diversified holding company with a variety of investments and a special interest in the education industry.
The block of stock was previously owned by Heartland Advisors Inc.
The company has not yet received a report of beneficial ownership on Schedule 13D relative to the foregoing transaction, it said.
